short_description.id: Kuntilanak adalah hantu berwujud perempuan gaib dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia dan Melayu yang dipercaya berasal dari wanita hamil yang meninggal dunia.
short_description.en: Kuntilanak is a female spirit in folklore of Indonesia and the Malay world believed to originate from a woman who died during pregnancy or childbirth.

long_description.id: Kuntilanak digambarkan sebagai sosok wanita berkulit pucat dengan rambut hitam legam panjang yang menutupi wajah serta mengenakan gaun putih panjang yang menutupi seluruh tubuh [kuntilanak-c04, kuntilanak-c11]. Sosok hantu ini gemar bersemayam di pohon tertentu seperti pohon waru doyong dan kerap meneror penduduk kampung di jalan sunyi untuk menuntut balas [kuntilanak-c06, kuntilanak-c07].
long_description.en: Kuntilanak is depicted as a pale ghostly woman with long black hair covering her face and wearing a long white dress that covers her body [kuntilanak-c04, kuntilanak-c11]. The spirit is reputed to haunt certain trees such as leaning waru trees and terrorizes village inhabitants on quiet roads to seek retribution [kuntilanak-c06, kuntilanak-c07].

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Melayu dan tradisi Nusantara, sosok kuntilanak memiliki rongga atau lubang di bagian belakang leher atau punggungnya sebagai tempat roh jahat bersemayam [kuntilanak-c05, kuntilanak-c12]. Masyarakat meyakini jika seseorang menancapkan paku tajam pada lubang di leher atau ubun-ubun kepalanya, sosok ini akan menjadi jinak dan menjelma menjadi wanita yang dapat dinikahi [kuntilanak-c09, kuntilanak-c10, kuntilanak-c16].
long_description.en: In Malay folklore and Nusantara tradition, the kuntilanak has a hollow cavity or hole in the back of her neck or back where the spirit dwells [kuntilanak-c05, kuntilanak-c12]. Popular belief holds that driving a sharp iron nail into her neck hole or into the crown of her head subdues her, turning her into a woman who can be wed [kuntilanak-c09, kuntilanak-c10, kuntilanak-c16].

cultural_context.id: Kepercayaan terhadap kuntilanak tersebar luas di Asia Tenggara seperti Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapura, Brunei Darussalam, Filipina, dan Thailand [kuntilanak-c17]. Di Kalimantan Barat, legenda tutur mengaitkan sejarah pendirian Kota Pontianak di pertemuan sungai Kapuas dan Landak dengan peristiwa pengusiran kuntilanak oleh Syarif Abdurrahman Alkadrie [kuntilanak-c13, kuntilanak-c14, kuntilanak-c18].
cultural_context.en: Belief in kuntilanak is widespread throughout Southeast Asia including Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei Darussalam, the Philippines, and Thailand [kuntilanak-c17]. In West Kalimantan, oral tradition links the founding of the city of Pontianak at the confluence of the Kapuas and Landak rivers to the banishing of kuntilanak by Syarif Abdurrahman Alkadrie [kuntilanak-c13, kuntilanak-c14, kuntilanak-c18].

summary.en: Syarif Abdurrahman Alkadrie, founder of the Sultanate of Pontianak, was troubled by kuntilanak spirits while establishing his palace at the confluence of the Kapuas and Landak rivers, and fired a cannon to banish the creatures.

traditional.id: Dalam kepercayaan tradisional Melayu dan Nusantara, kuntilanak adalah roh wanita yang meninggal saat bersalin dan menuntut balas dendam.
traditional.en: In traditional Malay and Nusantara belief, kuntilanak is a spirit of a woman who died during childbirth seeking vengeance.

long_description.id: Kuntilanak (atau Pontianak di Semenanjung Melayu dan Kalimantan Barat) adalah arwah penasaran yang paling terkenal di Asia Tenggara. Berwujud perempuan berambut hitam sangat panjang yang terurai hingga menutupi punggungnya, berbaju putih panjang, dan memancarkan aroma bunga kamboja yang seketika berubah menjadi bau busuk menyengat. Kuntilanak dikenal dengan tawa melengking bernada tinggi yang menipu pendengaran: jika tawanya terdengar jauh berarti ia sangat dekat, dan sebaliknya. Dalam tradisi lisan, ia dapat dicegah dengan menancapkan paku di lubang tengkuk kepalanya.
long_description.en: The Kuntilanak is an iconic female spirit of Southeast Asian lore. She is described as possessing cascading long black hair cloaking a flowing white garment. Her arrival is heralded by the sweet scent of frangipani blossoms abruptly turning into a decaying stench. Her laughter defies spatial acoustics: soft giggles suggest her proximity, whereas deafening shrieks indicate greater distance. Regional folklore speaks of driving an iron nail into the hollow of her neck to compel her into domestic human form.

short_description.id: Banshee adalah roh perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia yang kemunculan ratapannya menandai ajal anggota keluarga.
short_description.en: A banshee is a female spirit in Irish folklore whose wailing heralds the death of a family member.

long_description.id: Secara etimologi, nama banshee berasal dari bahasa Irlandia Kuno ben síde yang berarti wanita dari gundukan peri [banshee-c01]. Nama ini berhubungan dengan bukit atau gundukan kuno di pedesaan Irlandia [banshee-c02]. Sosok ini digambarkan berambut panjang terurai yang sedang disisir, memakai jubah kelabu di atas gaun hijau dengan mata merah karena menangis [banshee-c03, banshee-c04]. Kesaksian Ann Lady Fanshawe mencatat penampakan berbaju putih dengan rambut merah dan rona wajah pucat [banshee-c05].
long_description.en: Etymologically, the name banshee derives from Old Irish ben síde meaning woman of the fairy mound [banshee-c01]. Her name connects to ancient mounds across the Irish countryside [banshee-c02]. She is depicted with long streaming hair that she combs, wearing a grey cloak over a green dress with red eyes from weeping [banshee-c03, banshee-c04]. A firsthand account by Ann Lady Fanshawe recorded a figure in white with red hair and a ghastly complexion [banshee-c05].

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi lisan, banshee dikenal lewat jeritan atau ratapan yang menandai kematian seseorang [banshee-c01, banshee-c10, banshee-c11]. Legenda ini berakar dari tradisi keening atau ratapan perempuan pelayat dalam upacara pemakaman di Irlandia [banshee-c06, banshee-c07, banshee-c12, banshee-c13]. Perbedaan utamanya adalah banshee meramalkan kematian sebelum peristiwa itu terjadi [banshee-c14, banshee-c15]. Suara ratapan ini kerap disalahartikan sebagai jeritan hewan seperti rubah [banshee-c16]. Sosok ini juga dikisahkan mencuci pakaian bernoda darah di sungai serta membuntuti keluarga tertentu hingga ke negeri lain [banshee-c17, banshee-c18, banshee-c19, banshee-c20, banshee-c21].
long_description.en: In oral tradition, the banshee is known for screams and wails that herald someone's death [banshee-c01, banshee-c10, banshee-c11]. This lore stems from traditional funeral keening laments performed by women in Ireland [banshee-c06, banshee-c07, banshee-c12, banshee-c13]. The vital difference is that banshees predict a passing before it occurs [banshee-c14, banshee-c15]. Her cry is often mistaken for animal calls like a fox [banshee-c16]. Legends also describe her washing bloodstained clothes in rivers and following families across foreign lands [banshee-c17, banshee-c18, banshee-c19, banshee-c20, banshee-c21].

cultural_context.id: Bagi masyarakat Irlandia, mitos banshee mencerminkan tradisi perkabungan komunal melalui ratapan duka para pelayat, sekaligus menjadi pengingat leluhur dan batas takdir kematian bagi keluarga-keluarga tua.
cultural_context.en: In Irish culture, the banshee myth reflects communal mourning customs through funeral keening laments while serving as an ancestral reminder of mortality for traditional families.

description.id: Meramalkan kematian seseorang melalui jeritan dan ratapan duka.
description.en: Foretelling someone's passing through screams and mournful wails.

description.id: Membubung di atas angin sambil menjerit lalu terbang menjauh.
description.en: Rising upon the wind with shrieks and flying away.

description.id: Banshee bukan makhluk pemangsa jasmani melainkan pembawa kabar pertanda kematian.
description.en: The banshee is not a physical predator but an omen herald.

description.en: Term for the banshee in parts of Leinster as a keening woman with piercing wails.

title.en: Keening and the death of holy persons

summary.id: Ketika beberapa banshee muncul bersamaan, peristiwa itu menandai berpulangnya seorang tokoh agung atau orang suci. Kisah ini bertaut erat dengan peranan wanita peratap yang melantunkan duka pada upacara perkabungan.
summary.en: Folkloric tradition holds that the simultaneous appearance of several such entities heralds the demise of a venerable or holy personage. This motif is closely associated with keening women voicing laments during mourning ceremonies.

title.id: Perjumpaan Richard de Clare di sungai
title.en: Encounter of Richard de Clare at the river

summary.id: Pasukan Richard de Clare menjumpai perempuan tua keriput yang mencuci jubah dan zirah bernoda darah di sungai. Sosok perempuan itu menyatakan berasal dari gundukan peri berkabut dan menubuatkan kematian dalam pertempuran.
summary.en: The force of Richard de Clare encountered a wizened old woman washing bloodstained armour in a swift river. She declared herself from the misted fairy mounds and foretold death in battle.

description.id: Gundukan kuno yang tersebar di pedesaan Irlandia yang diyakini sebagai tempat tinggal peri.
description.en: Ancient mounds scattered across rural Ireland believed to be fairy dwellings.

traditional.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, banshee adalah roh perempuan atau peri yang meratap sebagai tanda duka dan pertanda ajal anggota keluarga.
traditional.en: In Irish folklore, the banshee is a female spirit or fairy whose wailing marks grief and heralds the death of a family member.

modern.id: Dalam media populer modern, sosok banshee kerap disederhanakan menjadi monster jeritan yang menyerang manusia atau hantu penakut.
modern.en: In modern media, the banshee is often flattened into an aggressive screaming monster or horror ghoul.

long_description.id: Banshee (berasal dari bahasa Gaelik Irlandia 'Bean Sídhe' yang berarti 'wanita dari bukit peri') adalah entitas supernatural yang terikat pada garis keturunan keluarga kuno Irlandia (seperti O'Neill, O'Brien, O'Connor). Banshee tidak membunuh manusia; kehadirannya adalah sebagai pembawa firasat (omen) melalui ratapan duka mendalam (keening) di malam hari. Ia dapat menampakkan diri dalam tiga wujud: seorang gadis muda dengan rambut emas kemerahan, seorang wanita anggun, atau seorang nenek renta berkerudung compang-camping dengan mata memerah karena menangis.
long_description.en: The Banshee (from Old Irish 'Bean Sídhe', woman of the fairy mounds) is one of the most poignant supernatural figures of Celtic tradition. She is spiritually bonded to historic noble Irish families. Rather than an aggressive monster, the Banshee serves as a harbingering witness to mortality. Her visitation is announced by blood-curdling lamentations (keening) echoing across marshlands under moonlit skies. She manifests as a maiden of radiant grief, a matron, or a cloaked crone whose eyes burn scarlet from weeping.

long_description.id: Secara etimologi, nama banshee berasal dari bahasa Irlandia Kuno ben síde yang berarti wanita dari gundukan peri [banshee-c01]. Nama ini berhubungan dengan bukit atau gundukan kuno di pedesaan Irlandia [banshee-c02]. Sosok ini digambarkan berambut panjang terurai yang sedang disisir, memakai jubah kelabu di atas gaun hijau dengan mata merah karena menangis [banshee-c03, banshee-c04]. Kesaksian Ann Lady Fanshawe mencatat penampakan berbaju putih dengan rambut merah dan rona wajah pucat [banshee-c05].
long_description.en: Etymologically, the name banshee derives from Old Irish ben síde meaning woman of the fairy mound [banshee-c01]. Her name connects to ancient mounds across the Irish countryside [banshee-c02]. She is depicted with long streaming hair that she combs, wearing a grey cloak over a green dress with red eyes from weeping [banshee-c03, banshee-c04]. A firsthand account by Ann Lady Fanshawe recorded a figure in white with red hair and a ghastly complexion [banshee-c05].

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi lisan, banshee dikenal lewat jeritan atau ratapan yang menandai kematian seseorang [banshee-c01, banshee-c10, banshee-c11]. Legenda ini berakar dari tradisi keening atau ratapan perempuan pelayat dalam upacara pemakaman di Irlandia [banshee-c06, banshee-c07, banshee-c12, banshee-c13]. Perbedaan utamanya adalah banshee meramalkan kematian sebelum peristiwa itu terjadi [banshee-c14, banshee-c15]. Suara ratapan ini kerap disalahartikan sebagai jeritan hewan seperti rubah [banshee-c16]. Sosok ini juga dikisahkan mencuci pakaian bernoda darah di sungai serta membuntuti keluarga tertentu hingga ke negeri lain [banshee-c17, banshee-c18, banshee-c19, banshee-c20, banshee-c21].
long_description.en: In oral tradition, the banshee is known for screams and wails that herald someone's death [banshee-c01, banshee-c10, banshee-c11]. This lore stems from traditional funeral keening laments performed by women in Ireland [banshee-c06, banshee-c07, banshee-c12, banshee-c13]. The vital difference is that banshees predict a passing before it occurs [banshee-c14, banshee-c15]. Her cry is often mistaken for animal calls like a fox [banshee-c16]. Legends also describe her washing bloodstained clothes in rivers and following families across foreign lands [banshee-c17, banshee-c18, banshee-c19, banshee-c20, banshee-c21].

cultural_context.id: Bagi masyarakat Irlandia, mitos banshee mencerminkan tradisi perkabungan komunal melalui ratapan duka para pelayat, sekaligus menjadi pengingat leluhur dan batas takdir kematian bagi keluarga-keluarga tua.
cultural_context.en: In Irish culture, the banshee myth reflects communal mourning customs through funeral keening laments while serving as an ancestral reminder of mortality for traditional families.

long_description.id: Banshee (berasal dari bahasa Gaelik Irlandia 'Bean Sídhe' yang berarti 'wanita dari bukit peri') adalah entitas supernatural yang terikat pada garis keturunan keluarga kuno Irlandia (seperti O'Neill, O'Brien, O'Connor). Banshee tidak membunuh manusia; kehadirannya adalah sebagai pembawa firasat (omen) melalui ratapan duka mendalam (keening) di malam hari. Ia dapat menampakkan diri dalam tiga wujud: seorang gadis muda dengan rambut emas kemerahan, seorang wanita anggun, atau seorang nenek renta berkerudung compang-camping dengan mata memerah karena menangis.
long_description.en: The Banshee (from Old Irish 'Bean Sídhe', woman of the fairy mounds) is one of the most poignant supernatural figures of Celtic tradition. She is spiritually bonded to historic noble Irish families. Rather than an aggressive monster, the Banshee serves as a harbingering witness to mortality. Her visitation is announced by blood-curdling lamentations (keening) echoing across marshlands under moonlit skies. She manifests as a maiden of radiant grief, a matron, or a cloaked crone whose eyes burn scarlet from weeping.

short_description.id: Baba Yaga adalah tokoh supernatural perempuan tua dalam folklor Slavia yang tinggal di gubuk berkaki ayam dan terbang mengendarai lesung kayu.
short_description.en: Baba Yaga is an elderly supernatural figure in Slavic folklore who dwells in a chicken-legged hut and flies inside a wooden mortar.

long_description.id: Secara etimologi, nama Baba dalam bahasa Slavia berarti nenek atau wanita tua [baba-yaga-c01]. Pada abad ke-19 Alexander Afanasyev mengusulkan hubungan nama Yaga dengan Proto-Slavia dan akar Sanskerta untuk ular [baba-yaga-c02]. Sosok ini dikenal di berbagai wilayah dengan sebutan Ježibaba di Ceko dan Slowakia [baba-yaga-c03, baba-yaga-c08], serta Baba Roga di Slavia Selatan [baba-yaga-c04]. Catatan tertulis mengenai Baba Yaga tercantum sejak tahun 1755 dalam buku tata bahasa Rusia karya Mikhail V. Lomonosov [baba-yaga-c05].
long_description.en: Etymologically, Baba in Slavic tongues means grandmother or old woman [baba-yaga-c01]. In the 19th century Alexander Afanasyev proposed a link between Yaga and Proto-Slavic and Sanskrit terms for serpent [baba-yaga-c02]. She is recognized regionally as Ježibaba among Czechs and Slovaks [baba-yaga-c03, baba-yaga-c08], and as Baba Roga across South Slavic lands [baba-yaga-c04]. Written attestation dates to 1755 in Mikhail V. Lomonosov Russian Grammar [baba-yaga-c05].

long_description.id: Kediaman Baba Yaga digambarkan sebagai gubuk kayu ajaib berkaki ayam yang mampu berputar atau berpindah tempat di dalam hutan [baba-yaga-c10, baba-yaga-c15]. Di dalamnya, hidung besarnya menyentuh langit-langit [baba-yaga-c10]. Halaman gubuk dikelilingi pagar tulang manusia dengan tengkorak, berengsel tulang kaki dan berkunci rahang bergigi tajam [baba-yaga-c12]. Bangunan panggung ini menyerupai pondok lumbung tradisional Finno-Ugrik di atas tunggul pohon berakar [baba-yaga-c06].
long_description.en: Baba Yaga abode is described as a magical wooden hut perched on chicken legs that turns or moves on command within the forest [baba-yaga-c10, baba-yaga-c15]. Inside, her large nose touches the ceiling [baba-yaga-c10]. Her yard is fenced with human bones topped by skulls, featuring foot-bone hinges and sharp-toothed jawbone locks [baba-yaga-c12]. This raised architecture resembles traditional Finno-Ugric stilt huts built on root stumps [baba-yaga-c06].

long_description.id: Dalam dongeng Vasilisa si Cantik, seorang gadis yatim piatu diutus ke gubuk Baba Yaga [baba-yaga-c17]. Alih-alih memangsa Vasilisa, Baba Yaga memaksanya melakukan tugas mustahil seperti memilah beras dari gandum sebelum fajar [baba-yaga-c18]. Vasilisa berhasil berkat boneka peninggalan ibunya, lalu diberi lentera tengkorak yang membakar keluarga tiri jahatnya [baba-yaga-c19]. Baba Yaga berperan ganda sebagai penipu sekaligus penyelamat [baba-yaga-c20]. Dalam kisah Putri Katak, Baba Yaga bersama saudari-saudarinya membantu Pangeran Ivan bersatu kembali dengan putri pujaannya [baba-yaga-c14].
long_description.en: In the folktale Vasilisa the Beautiful, an orphan is sent to Baba Yaga hut [baba-yaga-c17]. Instead of eating Vasilisa, Baba Yaga orders her to perform impossible tasks such as sorting rice from wheat before dawn [baba-yaga-c18]. Aided by her mother doll, Vasilisa succeeds and receives a skull lantern that burns her stepfamily [baba-yaga-c19]. Baba Yaga acts as trickster and savior [baba-yaga-c20]. In The Frog Princess, Baba Yaga and her sisters help Prince Ivan reunite with his runaway princess [baba-yaga-c14].

long_description.id: Para peneliti mengidentifikasi Baba Yaga sebagai penjaga mata air kehidupan dan lambang kemandirian perempuan dalam tradisi lisan Slavia [baba-yaga-c13]. Pada tahun 1874, Modest Mussorgsky menggubah suite Pictures at an Exhibition yang memuat bagian The Hut on Hen Legs, yang kemudian diaransemen oleh grup rock Emerson, Lake & Palmer [baba-yaga-c07]. Citra nenek sihir yang terbang di dalam lesung kayu sambil menyapu jejaknya menjadi salah satu motif folklor paling terkenal di dunia [baba-yaga-c11, baba-yaga-c21].
long_description.en: Scholars identify Baba Yaga as guardian of the fountains of the waters of life and an archetype of female autonomy in Slavic oral folklore [baba-yaga-c13]. In 1874, Modest Mussorgsky composed Pictures at an Exhibition featuring The Hut on Hen Legs, later arranged by rock band Emerson, Lake & Palmer [baba-yaga-c07]. Her flight in a wooden mortar while sweeping away tracks remains a world-renowned folklore motif [baba-yaga-c11, baba-yaga-c21].

cultural_context.id: Kisah Baba Yaga berfungsi sebagai dongeng pengingat batas moral dan kehati-hatian bagi anak-anak agar tidak tersesat di hutan, sekaligus menggambarkan ambiguitas alam liar yang memberi makan atau membinasakan.
cultural_context.en: Tales of Baba Yaga function as cautionary folklore teaching children caution in deep forests, while reflecting nature ambiguous power to sustain or destroy.

traditional.id: Dalam tradisi lisan Slavia kuno, Baba Yaga adalah tokoh ambigu yang menguji kelayakan manusia, bertindak sebagai penolong bertuah maupun pemangsa [baba-yaga-c09, baba-yaga-c13, baba-yaga-c16, baba-yaga-c20].
traditional.en: In ancient Slavic folklore, Baba Yaga is an ambiguous figure testing human worthiness, serving as a magical donor or a predator [baba-yaga-c09, baba-yaga-c13, baba-yaga-c16, baba-yaga-c20].

modern.id: Dalam media populer modern, sosoknya kerap disederhanakan menjadi penyihir jahat klise dalam genre horor atau fantasi [baba-yaga-c07, baba-yaga-c09].
modern.en: In modern popular media, she is frequently simplified into a cliché evil witch in horror or fantasy fiction [baba-yaga-c07, baba-yaga-c09].

summary.id: Pemangsa kanibalistik yang membinasakan anak-anak di dalam hutan [baba-yaga-c09, baba-yaga-c16].
summary.en: Cannibalistic predator devouring children deep in the forest [baba-yaga-c09, baba-yaga-c16].

summary.id: Penolong bijak dan pelindung mata air kehidupan yang menguji tamu sebelum memberi pertolongan [baba-yaga-c13, baba-yaga-c14, baba-yaga-c20].
summary.en: Wise donor and guardian of the waters of life testing guests before aiding them [baba-yaga-c13, baba-yaga-c14, baba-yaga-c20].

claims.quote: built on four tall chicken legs that can turn about or relocate on command. She is often seen draped over her stove or reclining in the hut across the entire expanse, with her large nose touching the ceiling.

statement.en: Baba Yaga hut is built on four tall chicken legs that can turn about or relocate on command, with her large nose touching the ceiling.

statement.en: Baba Yaga rides in a mortar propelled by a pestle with one hand while holding a broom in the other to wipe away traces of her tracks.

claims.quote: wall of human bones topped with skulls. The gate in the wall had hinges made from the bones of human feet and locks of jawbones set with sharp teeth.

statement.en: In The Frog Princess, Baba Yaga and her sisters play a pivotal role helping Prince Ivan reunite with his runaway princess.

claims.quote: According to folklore, Baba Yaga is a supernatural crone who lives deep in the Russian forest, in a house perched on chicken feet and surrounded by pine trees and glowing skulls.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat, Baba Yaga adalah perempuan tua supernatural yang tinggal jauh di dalam hutan Rusia di rumah berkaki ayam yang dikelilingi pohon pinus dan tengkorak bercahaya.
statement.en: According to folklore, Baba Yaga is a supernatural crone living deep in the Russian forest in a house on chicken feet surrounded by pine trees and glowing skulls.

claims.quote: Tales of her exploits vary, but typically she either aids young visitors who stumble upon her hut in their journeys, or she cuts things short by attempting to eat them.

statement.id: Kisah-kisah mengenainya bervariasi; ia bisa membantu pengunjung muda yang tersesat di gubuknya atau mencoba memakan mereka.
statement.en: Tales of her exploits vary, typically either aiding young visitors who stumble upon her hut or attempting to eat them.

claims.quote: In the tale of Vasilisa the Beautiful, arguably the most famous story in which Baba Yaga appears, Baba Yaga takes on several, seemingly conflicting roles.

statement.id: Dalam kisah Vasilisa si Cantik, cerita paling terkenal tentang Baba Yaga, sosok ini mengambil beberapa peran yang tampak bertentangan.
statement.en: In the tale of Vasilisa the Beautiful, the most famous story of Baba Yaga, she takes on several seemingly conflicting roles.

claims.quote: Baba Yaga forces her to do a series of seemingly impossible menial tasks, such as separating grains of rice from wheat kernels before dawn.

statement.id: Baba Yaga memaksa Vasilisa melakukan serangkaian tugas mustahil, seperti memisahkan butir beras dari biji gandum sebelum fajar.
statement.en: Baba Yaga forces Vasilisa to perform seemingly impossible menial tasks, such as separating rice from wheat before dawn.

claims.quote: When Vasilisa succeeds at this, she’s granted one of the skull lanterns that rings Baba’s house; upon returning home, the lantern immediately engulfs her horrible family in flames

statement.id: Ketika Vasilisa berhasil, ia diberi salah satu lentera tengkorak yang kemudian membakar habis keluarga tiri jahatnya saat tiba di rumah.
statement.en: When Vasilisa succeeds, she is granted a skull lantern that engulfs her cruel stepfamily in flames upon returning home.

claims.quote: Here, Baba acts as trickster, villain, and savior, ultimately helping Vasilisa to rid her of her stepfamily, albeit through shockingly violent and roundabout means.

statement.id: Baba Yaga bertindak sebagai penipu, penjahat, sekaligus penyelamat yang membebaskan Vasilisa dari tirani keluarga tirinya.
statement.en: Baba acts as trickster, villain, and savior, ultimately helping Vasilisa rid herself of her stepfamily through violent means.

claims.quote: Protruding from the top of a wooden mortar, the old crone squats, her thin lips as downcast as her dark eyes.

statement.id: Bermunculan dari lesung kayu, wanita tua ini berjongkok dengan bibir tipis terkatup dan mata gelap.
statement.en: Protruding from a wooden mortar, the old crone squats with thin downcast lips and dark eyes.

long_description.id: Baba Yaga adalah salah satu figur paling tak terlupakan dalam dongeng Slavia Timur. Digambarkan sebagai nenek tua bertubuh bungkuk dengan hidung bengkok dan 'kaki tulang' (kostyanaya noga). Baba Yaga tidak menaiki sapu konvensional, melainkan meluncur melintasi pepohonan di dalam lumpang kayu besar (stupa) sambil mengemudikannya dengan alu (pestle) dan menyapu jejaknya dengan sapu perak. Rumahnya berada jauh di pedalaman hutan lebat, bertengger di atas sepasang kaki ayam raksasa yang dapat berputar dan dikelilingi pagar dari tulang manusia.
long_description.en: Baba Yaga is an enigmatic, multifaceted archetype in Eastern European folklore. Rather than a straightforward villain, she occupies an ambiguous moral threshold: she can devour unwary travelers or bestow invaluable wisdom and magical artifacts upon the pure of heart. She traverses birch forests flying inside a wooden mortar (stupa), rowing with a pestle and erasing her airborne trail with a silver broom. Her secluded dwelling spins continually upon giant rooster legs, fenced with human bones.

short_description.id: Wewe Gombel adalah hantu dalam tradisi Jawa yang dipercaya menculik anak-anak telantar untuk membela mereka tanpa mencelakainya.
short_description.en: Wewe Gombel is a ghost in Javanese folklore believed to kidnap neglected children to protect them without causing harm.

long_description.id: Mitos Wewe Gombel berkembang di Semarang dan Jawa Tengah, dengan sebutan lain Kolong Wewe. Cerita rakyat menuturkan bahwa sosok ini adalah arwah perempuan yang bunuh diri di sebuah pohon di kawasan Bukit Gombel setelah membunuh suaminya yang berselingkuh karena perempuan tersebut tidak mampu memberikan keturunan.
long_description.en: The myth of Wewe Gombel developed in Semarang and Central Java, also known as Kolong Wewe. Folklore recounts that this entity is the ghost of a woman who committed suicide at a tree on Gombel Hill after killing her husband who cheated because she could not bear children.

long_description.id: Dipercaya bahwa Wewe Gombel adalah roh perempuan yang mati bunuh diri di kawasan Bukit Gombel setelah membunuh suaminya yang berselingkuh [wewe-gombel-c04]. Mitos ini diajarkan agar anak-anak berhati-hati dan tinggal di rumah pada malam hari [wewe-gombel-c15]. Ia menculik anak-anak untuk membela mereka dari kelalaian orang tua, bukan untuk mencelakainya [wewe-gombel-c01, wewe-gombel-c06], meski anak yang diculik konon diberi makan kotoran yang disamarkan agar bisu [wewe-gombel-c07].
long_description.en: Wewe Gombel is believed to be the ghost of a woman who committed suicide on Gombel Hill after killing her unfaithful husband [wewe-gombel-c04]. This myth is taught to encourage children to be cautious and stay at home at night [wewe-gombel-c15]. She kidnaps children to protect them from neglectful parents without harming them [wewe-gombel-c01, wewe-gombel-c06], though kidnapped children are allegedly fed disguised dung to render them mute [wewe-gombel-c07].

long_description.id: Cerita hantu Wewe Gombel sering digunakan orang tua untuk menakuti anak agar tidak berkeliaran sendirian di luar rumah. Dalam karya sinema modern, sutradara Joko Anwar mengangkat sosok ini dalam serial antologi Folklore berjudul A Mother's Love yang ditayangkan oleh HBO Asia pada tahun 2018.
long_description.en: Stories of Wewe Gombel are frequently used by parents to discourage children from wandering outside alone. In modern cinema, director Joko Anwar featured the entity in the HBO Asia horror anthology Folklore in the episode A Mother's Love in 2018.

cultural_context.id: Mitos Wewe Gombel berfungsi sebagai pengingat moral bagi orang tua agar tidak mengabaikan anak-anak mereka, sekaligus menjaga keselamatan anak dari bahaya luar rumah pada waktu gelap.
cultural_context.en: The myth serves as a moral reminder for parents not to neglect their children, while keeping children safe from outside hazards after dark.

long_description.id: Wewe Gombel adalah sosok supernatural legendaris asal kawasan bukit Gombel di Semarang, Jawa Tengah. Digambarkan sebagai wanita tua berambut gimbal panjang, berkulit keriput pucat, dan memiliki payudara yang sangat panjang dan menggelambir. Berbeda dengan monster predator yang memangsa korbannya, Wewe Gombel memiliki motif emosional yang tragis: ia diyakini sebagai arwah seorang wanita yang meninggal nestapa karena tidak bisa memiliki keturunan dan dicampakkan suaminya. Saat senja ('surup'), ia menyembunyikan anak-anak yang disia-siakan, disuapi makanan gaib yang menyerupai kotoran (namun tampak lezat bagi anak), dan hanya akan melepaskan anak tersebut jika orang tuanya menyesal dan bersungguh-sungguh mencari.
long_description.en: Wewe Gombel is a poignant supernatural entity native to the Gombel hills in Central Java. Depicted as an elderly woman with matted hair and conspicuously elongated, pendulous breasts, her folkloric purpose is surprisingly protective rather than strictly predatory. Legend tells of a heartbroken barren woman driven to despair by domestic abandonment. In death, she steals away children who suffer domestic neglect or mistreatment at twilight, sheltering them beneath her breasts and feeding them illusory meals until negligent parents acknowledge their wrongdoing and remorsefully seek their child.

short_description.en: Božalość is a messenger of death in the mythology of the Wends (Lusatian Sorbs), a woman in white who weeps under the window of someone about to die.

long_description.id: Božalość adalah pembawa kabar kemalangan atau kematian dalam mitologi Wend, yaitu orang Sorbia Lusatia. Sumber etnografi Jerman menerjemahkan namanya sebagai "Gottesklage", Ratapan Tuhan. Artikel W. v. Schulenburg tahun 1886 mengaitkannya dengan semak elder dan menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan berpakaian putih berambut panjang kusut dan bermata merah, sedangkan Biren Bonnerjea menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan kecil yang menangis di bawah jendela orang yang akan meninggal.
long_description.en: Božalość is a messenger of misfortune or death in the mythology of the Wends, the Lusatian Sorbs. German ethnographic sources rendered the name as "Gottesklage", God's Lament. An 1886 article by W. v. Schulenburg links it with the elder bush and describes a woman in white with long unkempt hair and red eyes, while Biren Bonnerjea describes a little woman who weeps under the window of someone about to die.

long_description.en: A parallel being, the bože sedleško, is described as a child in white; its appearance foretells coming death, fire, epidemic or flood.

long_description.en: Božalość, also transliterated as Božaloshtsh or Bozaloshtsh is a messenger of misfortune or death in Wendish mythology (Wends, Lusatian Sorbs). The name was translated in German ethnographic sources as "Gottesklage" i.e., "God's Lament"). An 1886 article Das Spreewaldhaus by W. v. Schulenburg associates it with the elder bush and describes it as a woman dressed in white with long, unkempt hair and red eyes: Sambucus nigra; weil einst die Božalość kam, die Gottesklage (die im Fliederstrauch sitzt), ein Weibchen, weiss gekleidet, mit langem verwilderten Haar und rothen Augen, als man H. brannte. Nach Hartknoch glaubten die Litthauer, unter Hollunderbäumen hätten Götter ihren Sitz,... Biren Bonnerjea describes it as a little woman with long hair, who cries under the window of someone who is about to die. A parallel creature is bože sedleško, described as a child in white clothes. The name is of unclear etymology (the apparent association with the words "seat", "to sit", is unclear). From some folk tales it appears that sedleško, according to pagan beliefs of Lusatian Sorbs, was in every house, a kind of house spirit. The descriptions vary. For example, sedleško may be seen or heard crying like a child, or appears as a white hen. An appearance of a bože sedleško manifests a coming misfortune: death, fire, epidemics, flood, etc. (See, e.g., Bože sedleško by Handrij Zejler in Upper Sorbian.) Jacob Grimm remarks that a similar term, sedlisko means 'nightmare (demonic creature)" in Czech language. Similarly, in Polish folk beliefs, siedlisko (also, siodło, siodełko) is a (demonic) nightmare, also referred to as gnieciuch, i.e., "something that presses". They are described as something that sits on a sleeping prone person (hence the etymology of "siedlisko").

short_description.id: Manusia ikan Liérganes adalah pemuda Cantabria yang hilang di laut pada 1674 dan konon ditangkap di Teluk Cádiz pada 1679 dengan sisik dan insang, kisah yang diyakini benar oleh Feijoo.
short_description.en: The fish-man of Liérganes is a Cantabrian youth lost at sea in 1674 and said to have been caught in the Bay of Cádiz in 1679 with scales and gills, a story Feijoo held to be true.

long_description.id: Menurut Feijoo, Francisco de la Vega Casar dari Liérganes, Cantabria, bekerja sebagai tukang kayu di Bilbao sampai malam Santo Yohanes 1674, ketika ia terseret arus saat berenang dan dianggap tenggelam. Pada 1679 nelayan di Teluk Cádiz menangkap makhluk berwujud pemuda berkulit putih berambut merah, bersisik di leher, perut, dan punggung serta tampak berinsang.
long_description.en: According to Feijoo, Francisco de la Vega Casar of Liérganes in Cantabria worked as a carpenter in Bilbao until St John's Eve 1674, when the current swept him away while swimming and he was thought drowned. In 1679 fishermen in the Bay of Cádiz caught a creature like a white-skinned, red-haired young man with scales on his throat, belly and back and what seemed to be gills.

long_description.id: Kisah ini pertama dicatat dalam Teatro crítico universal karya Benito Jerónimo Feijoo, yang meyakininya benar, lalu dibukukan José María Herrán pada 1877. Kini Liérganes memiliki pusat informasi dan patung manusia ikan di tepi Sungai Miera.
long_description.en: The story was first recorded in Benito Jerónimo Feijoo's Teatro crítico universal, who believed it true, and later told in a book by José María Herrán in 1877. Liérganes now has an interpretation centre and a fish-man statue on the Miera.

long_description.en: The fish-man of Liérganes (Spanish: El hombre pez) is an entity of the mythology of Cantabria, located in the north of Spain. short_description.id: Aloja atau dona d'aigua adalah peri air mitologi Katalan berambut emas yang tinggal di danau dan mata air Pyrenees, hidup ribuan tahun, dan dapat menjadi burung air.
short_description.en: The aloja or dona d'aigua is a golden-haired water fairy of Catalan mythology living in Pyrenean lakes and springs, who lives for thousands of years and can turn into a water bird.

long_description.id: Aloja, juga dona d'aigua atau goja, adalah perempuan air mitologi Katalan yang tinggal dekat air tawar yang dingin, dari danau Pyrenees sampai gua dan sungai bawah tanah. Mereka berambut emas atau merah, bermata hijau atau biru, suka bercermin di bawah bulan purnama, dan dapat menjadi burung air. Mereka tidak abadi tetapi hidup ribuan tahun, mendukung kelahiran dan kesuburan, dan dianggap adaptasi lokal nimfa.
long_description.en: The aloja, also dona d'aigua or goja, is a Catalan water-woman living by cold fresh water, from Pyrenean tarns to underground caves and streams. They have gold or red hair and green or blue eyes, like to see their reflection under the full moon, and can become water birds. Not immortal but living thousands of years, they favour births and fertility and are seen as a local form of the nymphs.

long_description.id: Danau tempat mereka mandi mendidih bila orang asing masuk. Dalam kisah pernikahan, suami yang membocorkan rahasia istrinya ditinggalkan bersama hilangnya kekayaannya. Di Mallorca, Maria Enganxa tinggal di sumur dan menarik anak dengan kaitnya.
long_description.en: Lakes where they bathe boil if a stranger enters. In marriage tales, a husband who reveals his wife's secret is abandoned and loses his wealth. In Mallorca, Maria Enganxa lives in wells and hooks children.

famous_for.id: Menikah dengan manusia dengan syarat rahasia.
famous_for.en: Marrying humans on condition of secrecy.

note.id: Dona d'aigua di Mallorca yang menarik anak dengan kaitnya.
note.en: The water-woman of Mallorca who hooks children.

claims.quote: In Catalan mythology an aloja ... also known as dona d'aigua, goja or paitida, is a feminine being that lives in places with fresh water. These "water-women" are said to be able to turn into water blackbirds.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Katalan, aloja (juga dona d'aigua, goja, atau paitida) adalah makhluk perempuan yang tinggal di tempat berair tawar dan konon dapat menjelma menjadi burung air (dipper).
statement.en: In Catalan mythology an aloja (also dona d'aigua, goja or paitida) is a female being living where there is fresh water, said to be able to turn into a water blackbird (dipper).

claims.quote: According to legend, these women are not immortal, but can live for thousands of years and retain their youth.

statement.id: Mereka tidak abadi, tetapi dapat hidup ribuan tahun dan tetap muda.
statement.en: They are not immortal but can live for thousands of years and stay young.

claims.quote: It is said that the lakes where the dones d'aigua bathe can boil in anger if any stranger enters them. In Mallorca, the most famous water-woman is Maria Enganxa. According to tradition, she lives inside all the wells and cisterns and takes all the children that pass near them with her hook.

statement.id: Danau tempat mereka mandi konon mendidih karena marah bila orang asing masuk; di Mallorca dona d'aigua paling terkenal adalah Maria Enganxa, yang tinggal di semua sumur dan bak air dan menarik anak yang lewat dengan kaitnya.
statement.en: The lakes where they bathe are said to boil with anger if a stranger enters; in Mallorca the most famous is Maria Enganxa, who lives in every well and cistern and hooks children who pass by.

claims.quote: According to myth, water-women are nocturnal; have shimmering gold or red hair, and emerald or deep blue eyes; wear fine, rich clothes; and enjoy viewing their reflections in lakes on full-moon nights.

statement.id: Mereka makhluk malam berambut emas atau merah berkilau, bermata hijau zamrud atau biru tua, berpakaian indah, dan suka bercermin di danau pada malam bulan purnama.
statement.en: They are nocturnal, with shimmering gold or red hair and emerald or deep blue eyes, wear fine clothes and like to see their reflection in lakes on full-moon nights.

claims.quote: Often, one of the conditions is that the husband cannot reveal that his wife is a water-woman. If he does, the water-woman leaves him and disappears with his fortune.

statement.id: Dalam kisah pernikahan dengan manusia, syaratnya sering bahwa sang suami tidak boleh membocorkan bahwa istrinya dona d'aigua; bila melanggar, ia pergi membawa kekayaannya.
statement.en: In tales of marriage with humans the condition is often that the husband must not reveal his wife is a water-woman; if he does, she leaves and takes his fortune.

claims.quote: Son genios que favorecen los nacimientos y la fertilidad, dadoras de vida y regeneradoras constantes de la naturaleza. Son en general benévolas, aunque debe tenerse prudencia si uno se las encuentra.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, mereka roh yang mendukung kelahiran dan kesuburan, pemberi kehidupan dan pemulih alam, umumnya baik hati meski perlu berhati-hati bila bertemu mereka.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article they are spirits favouring births and fertility, life-givers and renewers of nature, generally kindly though one should be careful on meeting them.

claims.quote: La palabra «goja» (cat. pl. «goges») podría venir del catalán antiguo o tal vez del occitano, con el significado de 'doncella joven', 'muchacha', 'niña'

statement.id: Kata goja mungkin berasal dari bahasa Katalan kuno atau Oksitan, berarti "gadis muda".
statement.en: The word goja may come from Old Catalan or Occitan, meaning 'young maiden'.

claims.quote: Habitan siempre cerca de aguas gélidas y azules: los estanques del Pirineo, torrentes y saltos de agua, fuentes de los bosques, pozas, manantiales, grutas húmedas, y corrientes y lagos subterráneos.

statement.id: Mereka selalu tinggal dekat air biru yang dingin: danau Pyrenees, sungai deras dan air terjun, mata air hutan, kolam, gua lembap, dan sungai serta danau bawah tanah.
statement.en: They always live near cold blue waters: Pyrenean tarns, torrents and waterfalls, forest springs, pools, damp caves and underground streams and lakes.

claims.quote: Son una adaptación local de las ninfas como representaciones de las fuerzas (femeninas) de la naturaleza.

statement.id: Mereka adaptasi lokal dari nimfa sebagai perwujudan kekuatan feminin alam.
statement.en: They are a local adaptation of the nymphs as embodiments of nature's feminine forces.

claims.quote: Viven en os Pireneus, en zonas an bi ha augua, ya sigan fuents, ríos, torrents u espelungas humedas.

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Aragon juga menyebut mereka tinggal di Pyrenees, di tempat berair seperti mata air, sungai, aliran deras, atau gua lembap.
statement.en: The Aragonese article also says they live in the Pyrenees where there is water, such as springs, rivers, torrents or damp caves.

short_description.id: Busaw adalah makhluk legenda Filipina yang tampak dan berperilaku seperti manusia biasa, tetapi sebenarnya roh jahat pemakan mayat dan pencuri jenazah.
short_description.en: The busaw is a legendary creature of the Philippines that looks and behaves like an ordinary human but is really an evil, corpse-stealing ghoul.

long_description.id: Busaw adalah makhluk legenda yang menyerupai manusia dalam rupa dan perilaku: ia beternak dan menanam umbi-umbian. Namun, makanan kesukaannya adalah manusia, sehingga kerangka manusia berserakan di sekitar tempat tinggalnya. Busaw dikaitkan dengan bal-bal, aswang, dan amalanhig sebagai sesama pemakan daging.
long_description.en: The busaw is a legendary creature that resembles humans in looks and behaviour, raising farm animals and planting root crops. Its favourite food, however, is humans, leaving human skeletons scattered around its dwelling. The busaw is associated with the bal-bal, aswang and amalanhig as fellow flesh-eaters.

long_description.id: Busaw adalah roh jahat pemakan mayat dan pencuri jenazah yang pada siang hari tampak seperti manusia biasa, tetapi pada malam hari mendengarkan tanda-tanda kematian dan tinggal di pohon besar dekat kuburan. Ia bergigi runcing, berkuku bengkok, dan berlidah panjang. Ia mencuri jenazah dari peti dan menggantinya dengan batang pisang, mengubah jenazah itu menjadi babi, lalu memakannya dan bahkan mencoba memberikannya kepada tetangga agar mereka ikut menjadi pemakan mayat. Untuk menangkalnya, jenazah harus dicuci dengan cuka dan rempah berbau tajam, dan garam juga dipercaya mengusirnya.
long_description.en: The busaw is an evil, corpse-stealing ghoul that looks like an ordinary person by day but at night listens for signs of death and dwells in large trees near cemeteries. It has pointed teeth, hooked nails and a long tongue. It steals corpses from coffins, replacing them with banana trunks, turns the corpse into a pig, feasts on it and even tries to feed it to neighbours to make them ghouls too. To ward it off, corpses should be washed with vinegar and strong-smelling herbs, and salt is also believed to deter it.

To ward the Busaw off, all corpses should be washed completely with vinegar and strong-smelling herbs. Salt is also a Busaw deterrent.

short_description.id: Ghillie Dhu (Gille Dubh) adalah peri lelaki penyendiri dalam folklor Skotlandia, berambut gelap dan berpakaian daun serta lumut, penjaga hutan birch.
short_description.en: The Ghillie Dhu (Gille Dubh) is a solitary male fairy of Scottish folklore, dark-haired and clad in leaves and moss, guardian of a birch wood.

long_description.id: Ghillie Dhu atau Gille Dubh adalah peri lelaki penyendiri dalam folklor Skotlandia. Ia berambut gelap dan berpakaian daun serta lumut, yang menjadi asal nama ghillie suit. Ia terutama muncul dalam kisah dari akhir abad ke-18, tinggal di hutan birch di Dataran Tinggi barat laut Skotlandia, menjaga hutan dengan garang dari orang luar tetapi baik kepada anak-anak. Ghillie adalah padanan Inggris untuk kata Gaelik Skotlandia gille ("pemuda"), dan dubh berarti "gelap".
long_description.en: The Ghillie Dhu or Gille Dubh is a solitary male fairy of Scottish folklore. He was dark-haired and dressed in leaves and moss, which gave the ghillie suit its name. He features mostly in accounts from the late 18th century, inhabiting a birch wood in the north-west Highlands of Scotland, guarding the forest fiercely from outsiders yet treating children kindly. Ghillie renders the Scottish Gaelic gille, 'lad', and dubh means 'dark'.

long_description.id: Menurut Katharine Briggs ia roh gunung yang lembut, pemalu tetapi bisa "liar", bertubuh kecil. Ia tinggal di hutan birch dekat Loch an Draing di Gairloch. Kisah paling terkenal menyebut gadis bernama Jessie Macrae yang tersesat di hutan; Ghillie Dhu menghiburnya dan mengantarnya pulang. Tuan tanah Sir Hector Mackenzie dari Gairloch kemudian mengajak lima bangsawan Mackenzie memburunya, tetapi gagal; menurut Patricia Monaghan, ia tak pernah terlihat lagi.
long_description.en: Katharine Briggs calls him a gentle mountain spirit, shy but able to be 'wild', and small in build. He lived in the birch woods by Loch an Draing in Gairloch. The best-known story tells of Jessie Macrae, a girl lost in the woods whom the Ghillie Dhu comforted and guided home. The landowner Sir Hector Mackenzie of Gairloch later had five Mackenzie gentlemen hunt him, without success; according to Patricia Monaghan he was never seen again.

long_description.en: Äbädä (Cyrillic: Әбәдә) is an innocent forest spirit in Turkic mythology. It looks like an old woman. Äbädä also is represented in mythologies of Siberian peoples. Äbädä is a demon or spirit. He is a Turkic forest being, similar in nature to the İyes. He protects the birds, trees, and animals of the forest; he appears in the shape of a human with blue skin, two great horns, green hair, and a long green beard across his face, carrying a club or whip indicating his mastery of the forest. He can shapeshift into many different forms. As a human, he looks like a peasant with glowing eyes, and his shoes are on backwards. Should one ever encounter an Äbädä, one must thwart him immediately by turning all one's clothes inside out and backwards, and placing one's shoes on the opposite feet.

short_description.en: The batibat is a vengeful demon of Ilocano folklore, an ancient, grossly obese tree-dwelling female spirit that smothers sleepers, causing sleep paralysis and nightmares.

long_description.id: Batibat adalah setan pendendam dalam cerita rakyat Ilokano; dalam cerita rakyat Tagalog ia disebut bangungot. Ia berwujud roh perempuan tua yang sangat gemuk dan tinggal di pohon. Batibat biasanya bersentuhan dengan manusia ketika pohon tempat tinggalnya ditebang, terutama bila kayunya dijadikan tiang rumah, sehingga ia pindah dan menghuni sisa pohonnya itu.
long_description.en: The batibat is a vengeful demon of Ilocano folklore; in Tagalog folklore it is called bangungot. It takes the form of an ancient, grossly obese female spirit dwelling in trees. The batibat usually comes into contact with humans when its tree is felled, especially when the wood becomes a house post, so it moves in with what remains of its tree.

long_description.id: Batibat melarang manusia tidur di dekat tiangnya. Bila seseorang tidur di sana, ia berubah ke wujud aslinya dan menyerang dengan menindih korban dan memasuki mimpinya, menyebabkan ketindihan dan mimpi buruk; karena itu kata Ilokano batíbat berarti mimpi buruk. Untuk menangkalnya, orang dianjurkan menggigit ibu jari atau menggerakkan jari kaki agar terbangun.
long_description.en: The batibat forbids humans to sleep near its post. If someone does, it takes its true form and attacks by smothering the victim and invading their dreams, causing sleep paralysis and waking nightmares; hence the Ilocano word batíbat means nightmare. To ward it off, one should bite one's thumb or wiggle one's toes to wake up.

long_description.en: The Batibat is a vengeful demon found in Ilocano folklore. In Tagalog folklore, the creature is called Bangungot. The batibat takes the form of an ancient, grotesquely obese, tree-dwelling female spirit. They usually come in contact with humans when the trees in which they reside are felled and are made homeless, especially when their tree is made into a support post for a house. This causes them to migrate and inhabit what is left of their tree. The batibat forbids humans from sleeping near its post. When a person does sleep near it, the batibat transforms into its true form and attacks the person by suffocating their victim and invading their dream space, causing sleep paralysis and waking nightmares. This condition lends itself to the Ilocano word for nightmare, "batíbat" (or bangungot in Tagalog). To ward off the batibat, one should bite one's thumb or wiggle one's toes. In this way, the person will awaken from the nightmare induced by the batibat.

short_description.id: Galtxagorriak adalah roh rumah kecil bercelana merah dalam cerita rakyat Basque yang mengerjakan tugas dengan sangat cepat bagi tuannya.
short_description.en: Galtxagorriak are tiny red-trousered house spirits of Basque folklore who do their master's tasks extremely quickly.

long_description.id: Galtxagorriak, "celana merah", adalah sejenis iratxoak atau roh rumah dalam cerita rakyat Basque. Mereka makhluk sangat kecil, kadang bersayap, bercelana merah, yang dapat disimpan dalam kotak. Bila seseorang menaruh wadah di atas semak pada malam Santo Yohanes, mereka masuk ke dalamnya dan orang itu menjadi tuan mereka.
long_description.en: Galtxagorriak, "red pants", are a kind of iratxoak or house spirit in Basque folklore. They are tiny, sometimes winged beings in red trousers that can be kept in boxes. If someone places a container on a bush on Saint John's Eve, they enter it and that person becomes their master.

long_description.id: Mereka bekerja sangat cepat tetapi marah bila kehabisan tugas; seorang lelaki mengusir mereka dengan menyuruh membawa saringan penuh air, sementara seorang petani Zarautz menang lomba lembu berkat bantuan mereka. Mereka juga dianggap pembantu penyihir, dan muncul dalam film animasi Teresa eta Galtzagorri tahun 2016.
long_description.en: They work extremely fast but get angry when they run out of tasks; one man got rid of them by asking for a sieve full of water, while a Zarautz farmer won an ox race with their help. They are also considered sorcerers' assistants, and appear in the 2016 animated film Teresa eta Galtzagorri.

short_description.id: Borda adalah penyihir mengerikan bermata tertutup dari Lembah Po, Italia, yang muncul dalam kabut dan membunuh orang di dekat rawa.
short_description.en: The Borda is a horrible blindfolded witch of Italy's Po Valley who appears in fog and kills people near marshes.

long_description.id: Borda adalah makhluk legendaris Emilia-Romagna dan Lembah Po, semacam penyihir mengerikan bermata tertutup yang muncul pada malam hari dan hari berkabut, tinggal di rawa, dan membunuh siapa pun yang bertemu dengannya, terutama anak-anak. Ia personifikasi ketakutan akan rawa dan kanal, dipakai untuk menjauhkan anak dari tempat berbahaya; sebuah nina bobo menyebutnya mengikat anak dengan tali lalu membunuhnya.
long_description.en: The Borda is a legendary creature of Emilia-Romagna and the Po Valley, a horrible blindfolded witch who appears at night and on foggy days, lives in marshes and kills anyone who meets her, especially children. She personifies the fear of marshes and canals, used to keep children from danger; a lullaby says she binds children with a rope and kills them.

long_description.id: Dalam dialek Milan dan Bormio, borda berarti kabut, dan bentuk maskulinnya Bordón atau Bordö berarti raksasa pemakan manusia. Sebagian peneliti merunut namanya ke Borvo, dewa Kelt penguasa mata air panas.
long_description.en: In the Milanese and Bormio dialects borda means fog, and the masculine Bordón or Bordö means ogre. Some scholars trace the name to Borvo, the Celtic god of hot springs.

who.en: A witch of fog and marsh.

note.id: Dewa Kelt yang mungkin menjadi asal namanya.
note.en: The Celtic god who may lie behind the name.

statement.en: The Borda is a legendary creature of the culture of Emilia-Romagna and other parts of the Po Valley in Italy.

claims.quote: It is a sort of witch that appears, blindfolded and horrible, both at night and on foggy days and kills anyone who has the misfortune to meet her.

statement.id: Ia semacam penyihir mengerikan bermata tertutup yang muncul pada malam hari dan hari berkabut, dan membunuh siapa pun yang malang bertemu dengannya.
statement.en: It is a kind of witch, blindfolded and horrible, that appears at night and on foggy days and kills anyone unlucky enough to meet her.

claims.quote: It is a personification of the fear related to swamps and marshlands, and to ponds and canals, invoked by adults to scare children and keep them away from such potentially dangerous places.

statement.id: Ia personifikasi ketakutan akan rawa, kolam, dan kanal, yang dipakai orang dewasa untuk menakuti anak-anak agar menjauhi tempat berbahaya itu.
statement.en: It personifies the fear of swamps, ponds and canals, invoked by adults to scare children away from such dangerous places.

statement.en: In Milanese, as in the Crema and Bormio dialects, the word borda means fog.

claims.quote: Some scholars of local folklore trace the etymology of the term Borda to the root "bor-" which can be traced back to Borvo, of Celtic mythology, who presided over thermal and spring waters

statement.en: Some local folklorists trace the name Borda to the root bor-, going back to Borvo of Celtic mythology, who presided over hot springs.

statement.en: A lullaby says the Borda binds beautiful children with a rope and then kills them.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Italia, Borda tinggal di daerah berawa tempat ia dapat membunuh semua orang yang lewat, terutama anak-anak.
statement.en: According to the Italian article, the Borda lives in marshy areas where she could kill any passer-by, especially children.

long_description.id: Amefurikozō (Jepang: 雨降小僧) adalah yokai yang disebut dalam cerita rakyat Jepang. Penampilan amefurikozo menyerupai anak laki-laki yang mengenakan kimono, bakiak kayu, dan topi jerami lebar atau payung di kepalanya. Mereka memiliki hidung yang montok dan terbalik. Langkah mereka kemana pun perginya selalu menyebabkan terbentuknya awan yang kemudian turunlah hujan. Di Tiongkok kuno, Amefurikozō diyakini sebagai pelayan rumah untuk dewa hujan, yang dikenal sebagai Ushi dalam bahasa Jepang.
long_description.en: Amefurikozō (雨降小僧, 雨降り小僧) is a type of Japanese yōkai. There is a depiction of this yōkai in Sekien Toriyama's collection of yōkai drawing the Konjaku Gazu Zoku Hyakki, and they can also be seen in the kibyōshi among other publications of the same era.

short_description.id: Brown Man of the Muirs adalah kurcaci dalam folklor perbatasan Inggris-Skotlandia yang menjadi roh pelindung hewan liar.
short_description.en: The Brown Man of the Muirs is a dwarf of Anglo-Scottish border folklore who acts as guardian spirit of wild animals.

long_description.id: Dalam folklor perbatasan Inggris-Skotlandia, Brown Man of the Muirs adalah kurcaci yang menjadi roh pelindung hewan liar. William Henderson, dalam Folklore of the Northern Counties (1879), memuat kisah dari surat sejarawan Robert Surtees kepada Sir Walter Scott: setahun sebelum Pemberontakan Besar, dua pemuda dari Newcastle berburu di padang tinggi di atas Elsdon, dan salah satunya melihat seorang kurcaci yang sangat kuat, berpakaian cokelat seperti pakis layu, berambut merah keriting, berwajah garang, dan bermata menyala seperti mata banteng.
long_description.en: In Anglo-Scottish border folklore the Brown Man of the Muirs is a dwarf who guards the wild creatures. William Henderson, in Folklore of the Northern Counties (1879), gives a tale from the historian Robert Surtees's letter to Sir Walter Scott: a year ahead of the Great Rebellion, a pair of Newcastle lads out shooting on the upland moors above Elsdon stopped to rest, and one saw a very strong, stocky dwarf dressed in brown like withered bracken, with frizzled red hair, a fierce face and eyes glowing like a bull's.

long_description.id: Kurcaci itu menegur sang pemburu karena memasuki wilayahnya dan membunuh makhluk-makhluk rakyatnya, mengatakan bahwa ia sendiri hanya makan buah beri, kacang dan apel, lalu mengundangnya pulang. Pemuda itu nyaris menyeberangi sungai ketika suara temannya menghentikannya, dan kurcaci itu menghilang; diyakini bila ia menyeberang ia akan dicabik-cabik. Ia tetap meninggal dalam setahun karena mengabaikan peringatan itu. Walter Scott menduga Brown Man berkerabat dengan duergar Northumberland.
long_description.en: The dwarf rebuked the hunter for trespassing on his lands and killing the creatures who were his subjects, said he himself ate only whortleberries, nuts and apples, and invited him home. The youth was about to leap the brook when his friend's voice stopped him, and the dwarf vanished; had he crossed, it was thought, he would have been torn apart. He died within the year all the same, for ignoring the warning. Walter Scott suggested the Brown Man was akin to the duergar of Northumberland.

did_you_know.en: The Brown Man of the Muirs reputedly ate only berries, nuts and apples, and rebuked hunters for killing his subjects.

short_description.id: Clíodhna adalah Ratu Banshee dari Tuatha Dé Danann dalam mitologi Irlandia, dalam sebagian mitos dewi cinta dan kecantikan serta pelindung County Cork.
short_description.en: Clíodhna is a Queen of the Banshees of the Tuatha Dé Danann in Irish myth, in some myths a goddess of love and beauty and patron of County Cork.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Irlandia (Irish), Clíodhna (Clídna, Clíodna, Clíona, kadang dianglisisasi menjadi Cleena) adalah Ratu Banshee (Queen of the Banshees) dari Tuatha Dé Danann. Clíodna dari Carrigcleena adalah banshee kuat yang memerintah sióga (peri) di South Munster atau Desmond. Dalam sebagian mitos ia dewi cinta dan kecantikan serta pelindung County Cork. Ia dikatakan memiliki tiga burung berwarna cerah yang memakan apel dari pohon dunia lain dan nyanyiannya menyembuhkan penyakit. Istananya berada di tengah tumpukan batu sekitar 8 km dari Mallow, yang masih dikenal sebagai Carrig-Cleena, dan petani Munster menganggapnya pelindung mereka.
long_description.en: In Irish myth Clíodhna (Clídna, Clíodna, Clíona, sometimes anglicised Cleena) is a Queen of the Banshees among the Tuatha Dé Danann. As Clíodna of Carrigcleena she is a powerful banshee reigning over the sióga (fairies) of South Munster, or Desmond. Some myths make her a goddess of love and beauty and patron of County Cork. She is said to keep three bright-coloured birds that feed on apples from an otherworld tree and whose song cures sickness. Her palace lay inside a heap of rocks about 8 km from Mallow, still called Carrig-Cleena, and the Munster country folk looked on her as their benefactor.

long_description.id: Menurut legenda Cleena's Wave dalam Acallam na Senórach, Ciabham putra raja Ulster diselamatkan ke Tír Tairngire, negeri Manannan; putri druid Gebann, Cleena, jatuh cinta dan pergi bersamanya, tetapi di pantai Irlandia orang-orang Manannan membuatnya tertidur dengan musik dan sebuah ombak besar menyapunya. Tempat itu disebut Tonn Chlíodhna, "Ombak Clíodhna", dekat pelabuhan Glandore. Menurut artikel de, Cormac Laidir Mac Carthy, pembangun Blarney Castle, meminta bantuan dewi itu dalam sengketa hukum; ia disuruh mencium batu pertama yang dilihatnya pagi itu, lalu memenangkan perkara berkat kefasihannya dan memasang batu itu di dinding bentengnya.
long_description.en: In the legend of Cleena's Wave in the Acallam na Senórach, Ciabham son of the king of Ulster is rescued to Tír Tairngire, Manannan's land; the druid Gebann's daughter Cleena falls in love and leaves with him, but on the Irish shore Manannan's people lull her to sleep with music and a great wave sweeps her off. The spot was named Tonn Chlíodhna, 'Clíodhna's Wave', near Glandore harbour. According to the de article, Cormac Laidir Mac Carthy, builder of Blarney Castle, asked the goddess for help in a lawsuit; told to kiss the first stone he saw that morning, he won through eloquence and set the stone high in his castle walls.

did_you_know.id: Menurut satu legenda, Clíodhna menyuruh pembangun Blarney Castle mencium sebuah batu, yang kemudian dipasang di dinding benteng itu.
did_you_know.en: One legend says Clíodhna told the builder of Blarney Castle to kiss a stone, which was then set in the castle walls.

short_description.id: Selkie adalah makhluk mitologi yang dapat berubah wujud antara anjing laut dan manusia dengan melepas atau memakai kulit anjing lautnya, terutama dalam tradisi Kelt dan Nordik.
short_description.en: Selkies are mythological creatures that shift between seal and human form by taking off or putting on their sealskin, chiefly in Celtic and Norse tradition.

long_description.id: Selkie adalah makhluk mitologi yang dapat berubah wujud antara anjing laut dan manusia dengan melepas atau memakai kulit anjing lautnya. Mereka menonjol dalam tradisi lisan dan mitologi berbagai budaya, terutama Kelt dan Nordik (Celtic, Norse). Kata selkie berasal dari kata Skots untuk anjing laut, dan mereka kadang disebut selkie fowk, "bangsa anjing laut". Selkie terutama dikaitkan dengan Northern Isles Skotlandia, tempat mereka hidup sebagai anjing laut di laut tetapi melepas kulitnya untuk menjadi manusia di darat.
long_description.en: Selkies are mythological creatures that shapeshift between seal and human by removing or donning their sealskin. They feature in the oral traditions and mythology of many cultures, especially Celtic and Norse ones. The word selkie comes from the Scots word for seal, and they are sometimes called selkie fowk, "seal folk". They are chiefly tied to the Northern Isles of Scotland, where they live as seals in the sea but shed their skins to become human on land.

long_description.id: Selkie bersifat ganda: mereka bisa ramah dan menolong manusia, tetapi juga berbahaya dan pendendam. Dalam wujud manusia mereka sering menarik dan memikat, dan banyak kisah tentang hubungan cinta selkie dengan manusia yang kadang melahirkan anak. Selkie juga bisa dipaksa atau ditipu menikahi manusia, biasanya oleh orang yang mencuri dan menyembunyikan kulit anjing lautnya; pernikahan seperti itu sering tak bahagia, karena selkie selalu merindukan laut dan dapat kabur bila menemukan kulitnya.
long_description.en: Selkies have a double nature: they can be friendly and helpful to humans, but also dangerous and vengeful. In human form they are often attractive and seductive, and many tales tell of love affairs between selkies and humans, sometimes producing children. A selkie may also be forced or tricked into marrying a human, usually one who steals and hides its sealskin; such marriages are often unhappy, for the selkie always longs for the sea and may flee if it finds its skin.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel id, selkie ditemukan dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, Skotlandia, dan Faroe, dan kisahnya sangat mirip dengan kisah gadis angsa. Selkie laki-laki digambarkan sangat tampan dalam wujud manusia dan memiliki daya besar untuk menggoda perempuan, terutama yang tidak puas dengan hidupnya, seperti istri nelayan yang menunggu suaminya.

long_description.id: Selkies (juga dieja silkies, sylkies, selchies; bahasa Irlandia: chéile séala, bahasa Skots: selkie fowk) adalah makhluk mitologi yang ditemukan di Irlandia, Skotlandia, dan cerita rakyat Faroe. Makhluk serupa juga dijelaskan dalam tradisi Islandia. Selkies adalah kata untuk hidup sebagai anjing laut di laut tetapi melepaskan kulit mereka untuk menjadi manusia di darat. Legenda ini rupanya yang paling umum di Kepulauan Northern dari Skotlandia dan ini sangat mirip dengan kisah gadis angsa.
long_description.en: Selkies are mythological creatures that can shapeshift between seal and human forms by removing or putting on their seal skin. They feature prominently in the oral traditions and mythology of various cultures, especially those of Celtic and Norse origin. The term "selkie" derives from the Scots word for "seal", and is also spelled as silkies, sylkies, or selchies. Selkies are sometimes referred to as selkie folk (Scots: selkie fowk), meaning "seal folk". Selkies are mainly associated with the Northern Isles of Scotland, where they are said to live as seals in the sea but shed their skin to become human on land. Selkies have a dual nature: they can be friendly and helpful to humans, but they can also be dangerous and vengeful. Selkies are often depicted as attractive and seductive in human form, and many stories involve selkies having romantic or sexual relationships with humans, sometimes resulting in children. Selkies can also be coerced or tricked into marrying humans, usually by someone who steals and hides their seal skin, preventing them from returning to the sea. Such marriages are often unhappy, as the selkie always longs for the sea and may eventually escape if they find their skin. Selkies have counterparts in other cultures. They are sometimes confused with other seal-like creatures, such as the mermaids or the finfolk. Selkies have inspired many works of art, literature, music, and film.

Mereka menonjol dalam tradisi lisan dan mitologi berbagai budaya, terutama Kelt dan Nordik (Celtic, Norse). long_description.en: Selkies are mythological creatures that shapeshift between seal and human by removing or donning their sealskin. They feature in the oral traditions and mythology of many cultures, especially Celtic and Norse ones. The word selkie comes from the Scots word for seal, and they are sometimes called selkie fowk, "seal folk". They are chiefly tied to the Northern Isles of Scotland, where they live as seals in the sea but shed their skins to become human on land.

long_description.id: Selkie bersifat ganda: mereka bisa ramah dan menolong manusia, tetapi juga berbahaya dan pendendam. Dalam wujud manusia mereka sering menarik dan memikat, dan banyak kisah tentang hubungan cinta selkie dengan manusia yang kadang melahirkan anak. Selkie juga bisa dipaksa atau ditipu menikahi manusia, biasanya oleh orang yang mencuri dan menyembunyikan kulit anjing lautnya; pernikahan seperti itu sering tak bahagia, karena selkie selalu merindukan laut dan dapat kabur bila menemukan kulitnya.
long_description.en: Selkies have a double nature: they can be friendly and helpful to humans, but also dangerous and vengeful. long_description.id: Selkies (juga dieja silkies, sylkies, selchies; bahasa Irlandia: chéile séala, bahasa Skots: selkie fowk) adalah makhluk mitologi yang ditemukan di Irlandia, Skotlandia, dan cerita rakyat Faroe. Makhluk serupa juga dijelaskan dalam tradisi Islandia. Selkies adalah kata untuk hidup sebagai anjing laut di laut tetapi melepaskan kulit mereka untuk menjadi manusia di darat. Legenda ini rupanya yang paling umum di Kepulauan Northern dari Skotlandia dan ini sangat mirip dengan kisah gadis angsa.
long_description.en: Selkies are mythological creatures that can shapeshift between seal and human forms by removing or putting on their seal skin. They feature prominently in the oral traditions and mythology of various cultures, especially those of Celtic and Norse origin. The term "selkie" derives from the Scots word for "seal", and is also spelled as silkies, sylkies, or selchies. Selkies are sometimes referred to as selkie folk (Scots: selkie fowk), meaning "seal folk". Selkies are mainly associated with the Northern Isles of Scotland, where they are said to live as seals in the sea but shed their skin to become human on land. Selkies have a dual nature: they can be friendly and helpful to humans, but they can also be dangerous and vengeful. Selkies are often depicted as attractive and seductive in human form, and many stories involve selkies having romantic or sexual relationships with humans, sometimes resulting in children. Selkies can also be coerced or tricked into marrying humans, usually by someone who steals and hides their seal skin, preventing them from returning to the sea. Such marriages are often unhappy, as the selkie always longs for the sea and may eventually escape if they find their skin. Selkies have counterparts in other cultures. They are sometimes confused with other seal-like creatures, such as the mermaids or the finfolk. Selkies have inspired many works of art, literature, music, and film.

short_description.id: Leprechaun adalah makhluk gaib bertubuh kecil dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, oleh sebagian digolongkan sebagai peri penyendiri, yang digambarkan sebagai lelaki kecil berjanggut yang suka berbuat usil.
short_description.en: The leprechaun is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, classed by some as a solitary fairy, pictured as a little bearded man fond of mischief.

long_description.id: Leprechaun (bahasa Irlandia: leipreachán) adalah makhluk gaib bertubuh kecil dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia (Irish folklore), yang oleh sebagian orang digolongkan sebagai sejenis peri penyendiri. Ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai lelaki kecil berjanggut bermantel dan bertopi yang suka berbuat usil; belakangan ia digambarkan sebagai pembuat sepatu yang menyimpan sepanci emas di ujung pelangi. Kata leprechaun berasal dari bahasa Irlandia Kuno luchorpán atau lupracán.
long_description.en: The leprechaun (Irish: leipreachán) is a diminutive supernatural being of Irish folklore, classed by some as a type of solitary fairy. It is usually pictured as a small bearded man in a coat and hat who gets up to mischief; in later times it became a shoemaker with a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. The word comes from Old Irish luchorpán or lupracán.

long_description.id: Rujukan tertua tentang leprechaun terdapat dalam kisah abad pertengahan Echtra Fergus mac Léti: Fergus mac Léti, raja Ulster, tertidur di pantai dan terbangun ketika diseret ke laut oleh tiga lúchorpáin; ia menangkap mereka, dan mereka memberinya tiga permintaan agar dilepaskan. Dalam cerita rakyat, leprechaun adalah makhluk penyendiri yang pekerjaan utamanya membuat dan menambal sepatu dan yang gemar bercanda; manusia yang menangkapnya dapat menolak melepaskannya sampai diberi kekayaan gaib.
long_description.en: The earliest known reference to the leprechaun is in the medieval tale Echtra Fergus mac Léti: the Ulster king Fergus mac Léti dozes off on the shore and awakes to find three lúchorpáin hauling him into the waves; he captures them, and they grant him three wishes for their release. In folklore the leprechaun is a solitary creature whose main work is making and cobbling shoes and who loves practical jokes; a human who catches one may refuse to free it until given supernatural wealth.

long_description.id: William Butler Yeats menggolongkan leprechaun sebagai "peri penyendiri" dan menyebut kekayaannya berasal dari guci harta yang dikubur pada masa perang. Sebelum abad ke-20 leprechaun umumnya dibayangkan berbaju merah, bukan hijau; gambaran modern dengan topi hijau dan janggut merah adalah ciptaan yang lebih baru. Menurut artikel id, leprechaun adalah sebangsa peri jantan yang mendiami Irlandia sebelum kedatangan bangsa Kelt, dan siapa pun yang mencuri gentong emasnya dapat meminta tiga permintaan sebagai ganti gentong itu; ia juga dikaitkan dengan perayaan Hari Santo Patrick.
long_description.en: William Butler Yeats classed the leprechaun as a "solitary fairy" and said its wealth came from treasure-crocks buried in wartime. Before the 20th century the leprechaun was generally held to wear red, not green; the modern image with green hat and red beard is a later invention. According to the id article, the leprechaun is a male fairy folk dwelling in Ireland before the coming of the Celts, and whoever steals its pot of gold may claim three wishes in exchange for its return; it is also linked with Saint Patrick's Day.

Karena itu disetiap negara saat merayakan hari ini anak-anak mulai berlomba-lomba untuk menangkap leprechaun. Cerita rakyat tentang leprechaun ini berasal dari Irlandia, mulai tersebar bersamaan dengan tersebarnya perayaan hari St. Patrick ke berbagai negara.

They are usually depicted as little bearded men, wearing a coat and hat, who partake in mischief. In later times, they have been depicted as shoe-makers who have a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. Leprechaun-like creatures rarely appear in Irish mythology and only became prominent in later folklore.

long_description.id: Leprechaun (bahasa Irlandia: leipreachán) dalam mitologi Irlandia adalah sebangsa peri jantan yang mendiami daratan Irlandia. Bersama peri-peri lainnya, Leprechaun mendiami daratan Irlandia sebelum kedatangan bangsa Kelt. Mereka digambarkan sebagai lelaki tua yang senang berbuat nakal. Mereka berdagang dengan menjual batu kerikil atau menjadi pembuat sepatu. Mereka dikatakan sangat kaya. Menurut legenda, leprechaun memiliki sebuah gentong yang berisi emas. Gentong tersebut dikatakan di letakkan di ujung pelangi. Dikatakan bahwa siapapun yang berhasil mencuri gentong emas tersebut, maka sang dewa muslihat tersebut harus mengabulkan 3 permintaan jika gentongnya ingin dikembalikan. Pada saat perayaan Hari Hijau atau hari untuk mengingat Santo Patrick, dikatakan leprechaun akan datang kerumah seseorang. Karena itu disetiap negara saat merayakan hari ini anak-anak mulai berlomba-lomba untuk menangkap leprechaun. Cerita rakyat tentang leprechaun ini berasal dari Irlandia, mulai tersebar bersamaan dengan tersebarnya perayaan hari St. Patrick ke berbagai negara.
long_description.en: A leprechaun (Irish: lucharachán/leipreachán/luchorpán) is a diminutive supernatural being in Irish folklore, classed by some as a type of solitary fairy. They are usually depicted as little bearded men, wearing a coat and hat, who partake in mischief. In later times, they have been depicted as shoe-makers who have a hidden pot of gold at the end of the rainbow. Leprechaun-like creatures rarely appear in Irish mythology and only became prominent in later folklore.

long_description.id: Yuki-onna (雪女, secara harfiah berarti "Wanita Salju") adalah sosok spirit atau yōkai dalam cerita rakyat Jepang. Ia merupakan figur populer dalam sastra Jepang, manga, dan anime. Kadang kala ia juga disebut sebagai Gadis Salju (雪娘, Yuki-musume), Peri Salju (yuki-onago), Sundal Salju (yukijorō), Kakak Salju (yuki anesa), Ibu Salju (yuki-omba), Nenek Salju (yukinba; dari Ehime）, yukifuri-baba (dari Nagano).
long_description.en: Yuki-onna (雪女; lit. 'snow woman') is a yūrei or yōkai in Japanese folklore that is often depicted in Japanese literature, films, or animation. She may also go by such names as yuki-musume (雪娘, "snow daughter"), yukihime (雪姫, "snow princess"), yuki-onago (雪女子, "snow girl"), yukijorō (雪女郎, "snow woman"), yuki anesa (雪姉さ, "snow sis"), yuki-onba (雪乳母, "snow granny" or "snow nanny"), yukinba (雪婆, "snow hag") in Ehime, yukifuri-baba (雪降り婆々, "snowfall witch" or "snowfall hag") in Nagano. They are also called several names that are related to icicles, such as tsurara-onna, kanekori-musume, and shigama-nyōbō.

long_description.id: Pangu (54000 — 18000 SM) (Pinyin: Pángǔ Shì; Hanzi Sederhana: 盘古氏; Hanzi tradisional: 盤古氏) adalah salah satu tokoh dalam cerita mitologi Tiongkok. Ada orang yang menganggap Pangu sebagai penjelmaan dari Yuanshi Tianzhun (Pīnyīn: Yuán Shǐ Tiān Zhūn; Hanzi: 元始天尊) dalam ajaran Taoisme. Legenda tentang Pangu terdapat banyak versi, tetapi secara umum memiliki persamaan anggapan bahwa Pangu adalah tokoh pembuka langit dan bumi. Dalam berbagai versi umum legenda tentang Pangu, kebanyakan terdapat isi cerita seperti berikut ini: Pada mulanya langit dan bumi kacau tanpa bentuk, Pangu lahir pada langit dan bumi kacau tanpa bentuk tersebut. Setelah 18.000 tahun, Pangu memakai sebuah kapak membelah langit dan bumi. Yang ringan dan terang naik ke atas menjadi langit; yang berat dan suram turun ke bawah menjadi bumi. Pangu takut langit dan bumi akan bergabung kembali, maka ia berdiri menahan langit dan bumi. Langit setiap hari naik 10 mistar, Pangu juga setiap hari bertambah tinggi 10 mistar. Setelah 18.000 tahun kemudian, Pangu meninggal dan organ tubuhnya menjadi berbagai barang di alam semesta ini: badannya berubah menjadi pegunungan, darahnya mengalir membentuk sungai, ototnya berubah menjadi tanah yang subur, sumsum tulangnya berubah menjadi mineral, giginya berubah menjadi batu permata, kulit dan bulu badannya berubah menjadi berbagai tanaman... Ada orang yang menganggap bahwa legenda tentang Pangu adalah legenda yang diciptakan oleh orang zaman dahulu kala dengan menyerap legenda tentang Panhu (盘瓠) atau Pangu dari suku minoritas di selatan, ditambah dengan unsur filsafat kuno dan imajinasi pribadi untuk mengisi kekosongan zaman. Cerita tentang Pangu, paling awal ditemukan dalam karya dari Xu Zheng, Sanwu Liji (三五历记) pada zaman Tiga Negara.
long_description.en: Pangu or Pan Gu (also sometimes spelled Peng Gu and P’an-ku) (Chinese: 盤古; pinyin: Pángǔ ; PAN-koo) is a primordial being and creation figure in Chinese mythology and in Taoism. According to legend, Pangu separated heaven and earth, and his body later became geographic features such as mountains and flowing water.
